Preserve accurately typed production-compatible session injection and executed HTTP/state/navigation assertions. Keep the original ordinary suites, with only the two existing separate browser exclusions. The attached read-only reference 00669e94-caad-4866-b487-dfe359bec458 provides authentic saved files at .atoma-runs/node_modules/00669e94-caad-4866-b487-dfe359bec458/. Do not invent a baseline or modify the reference. Use only offline synthetic fixtures and package registries. No live xe.gr or Spitogatos traffic, personal profiles, real-site cookies, secrets, hosting activation, client acceptance or publication. Synthetic fixture cookies are permitted. Do not import or execute collect-spitogatos.mjs. Leave the separate known Chromium dependency/cleanup harness issue for a later bounded run. Exercise the full HTTP challenge/ordinary matrix after that fresh build. Ensure the final saved compiled output was built from that same final source and repeat the behavior on it; a previous intermediate check or stale dist is not final proof.
